act_advancement: Count all clue keys, including pz-puzzle markers, at thresholds2/4/6/8/10; public page-reading alone obtains18 actual clues and reaches act5. Final ending requirements count only actual evidence list (H), not pz markers.
latching: Judge latches solvedPuzzles from original saved state. Ending also requires visible title; stale ending after reload does not count. New run uses fresh context.
failures: Wrong nonempty answers show retry message; empty answers do nothing; special endings show locked explanatory toast until requirements met. No finite attempt/life loss or terminal failure implemented.
reset: Author ending restart preserves evidence, solved puzzles, tenants and notes; title restart is confirmed destructive reset; title restart is only displayed after saved flag loaded by browser reload. Harness reset creates fresh context.
overlay_compatibility: Browser overlay internal data-page-id anchors now open existing local SPA content via delegated click; visual-only overlay navigation does not itself trigger main-view evidence collection. Original source and diff retained.
